title: Printed paper bags sourcing checklist for European buyers - MUGE PACKAGING SourceBridge
company: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
buyer_question: What should European buyers check before ordering printed paper bags from overseas suppliers?
product_line: Printed paper bags and paper packaging
buyer_context: European retail brands, boutiques, ecommerce sellers and brand owners comparing printed paper bags, kraft paper bags, shopping bags and paper packaging programs.
answer: European buyers should check the bag size, paper direction, handle structure, print coverage, finish reference, packing method, target market and document requirements before asking for a quote. MUGE PACKAGING treats sustainability, food-contact or regulated-market files as separate project documents that must be reviewed before any claim is used externally.
rfq_inputs: Bag width, height and gusset size
Product weight and intended retail use
Paper direction such as kraft paper, art paper or white card paper
Handle type, handle reinforcement and carrying expectation
Print coverage, artwork status and brand color requirements
Surface finish reference such as matte, gloss, texture or foil direction
Target market and any document-review requirement
